200 Returns the agent group details.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The unique ID of the agent group.
string
The UUID of the agent group.
string
The name of the agent group.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the agent
group was created.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the agent
group was last modified.
offset
sort
id
uuid
name
creation_date
last_modification_date
integer
Indicates whether or not the agent group is shared.
string
The username for the owner of the agent group.
string
The unique ID of the owner of the agent group.
string
The name of the owner of the agent group.
string
The UUID of the owner of the agent group.
integer
The sharing permissions for the agent group.
integer
The number of agents in the group.
object
object
An object containing pagination information for the current
result set.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view the agent group.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified agent group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
